_comment: Cross-reference of saSkillData[] indices (SkillManager.h, authoritative) with EU rebalanced skill tree (skills-eu.json). Generated 2026-08-24.

summary.level_mismatch_note: skills.json contains no character-level requirements (fields: skillIndex, name, active, iconFile only), and no other server-side source defines them; our_level/level_match are null everywhere. Re-run comparison once levels are added to skills.json.
summary.name_match_rule: true when normalized names are equal, Levenshtein distance <= 2, or one contains the other
summary.matching_method: EU 'code' matched case-insensitively against authoritative saSkillData names from SkillManager.h within the same class block; EU icon numbers are legacy per-class icon ids (not global saSkillData indices) and are kept only as reference.
